labels.name: sec.effect
labels.asks_about: What the call does to the systems it touches

labels.name: sec.reversibility
labels.asks_about: Whether the call's effects could be undone

labels.name: sec.data_class
labels.asks_about: Whether the call touches sensitive data, and which kind

labels.name: sec.trifecta
labels.asks_about: Three yes/no checks: private data, untrusted input, and a way out.
labels.asked_when: Always (name_only or above); at name_only, from the tool's documented behavior

sub_labels.name: sec.trifecta.private_source
sub_labels.asks_about: Whether the call accesses data that isn't public
sub_labels.asked_when: Always (name_only or above); at name_only, from the tool's documented behavior

sub_labels.name: sec.trifecta.untrusted_source
sub_labels.asks_about: Whether the call brings in content from outside the user's control
sub_labels.asked_when: Always (name_only or above); at name_only, from the tool's documented behavior

sub_labels.name: sec.trifecta.sink
sub_labels.asks_about: Whether the call sends data off the machine to an unconfirmed destination
sub_labels.asked_when: Always (name_only or above); at name_only, from the tool's documented behavior

labels.name: sec.intent
labels.asks_about: What the call is for, as a category

labels.name: sec.injection
labels.asks_about: Whether incoming content tries to direct the agent beyond the content's purpose
labels.asked_when: The call has incoming content, at any basis: its output, or for a return-path tool, its content-carrying argument
